name: Village chicken
summary: Gà bản is village chicken, firm, fragrant, and naturally sweet, boiled, steamed, grilled, or cooked with mountain vegetables.
origin: A midday and evening table in Cao Bang.
howToEat: In the evening, try it stewed with red pumpkin, the sweet meat against soft, nutty squash. Gà bản hầm hạt dẻ is the chestnut stew of the same bird.
where: Midday and evening tables in Cao Bang.
